summary.text: Magic 2012 follows planeswalkers connected to Ravnica, where Jace turns against and defeats Tezzeret and becomes de facto leader of the Consortium's Ravnica cell.
Chandra steals a scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai, and Jace is hired to recover it, which leads both planeswalkers to the Eye of Ugin.
Gideon and Sorin join the planeswalker lineup in place of Ajani and Liliana.
